body:
# Mod Description

This mod adds Platinum-based content to Minecraft, expanding the game with new materials, tools, armor, and blocks while keeping balance close to vanilla progression.

### 🔹 New Blocks

Platinum Block: A solid decorative storage block made from platinum ingots, mainly used for building and crafting.

### 🔹 New Items & Tools

Platinum Tools (Axe, Pickaxe, Shovel, Sword):
These tools are more durable and efficient than iron tools, offering a mid-to-late game alternative without being overpowered compared to diamond or netherite.

### 🔹 New Armor Set

Platinum Armor Set (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots):
Provides better protection than iron armor while maintaining balanced stats suitable for survival gameplay.

### 🎮 Gameplay Purpose

The mod is designed to enhance survival progression by introducing a new material that fits naturally into the vanilla game, giving players more variety in tools, armor, and building options.

### ⚙️ Mod Details

 Loader: NeoForge

 Minecraft Version: 1.21.1
